about: Breaking releases not yet adopted — a new major, or below 1.0 a new minor (give `minor` too) — each with why and until when. Read by scripts/check-dependency-drift.mjs: an entry past its reviewBy date, or one matching nothing outdated, fails the check. Remove an entry in the commit that adopts the major.

deferrals.reason: the published board library (0.44.0) and MCP server (0.29.0) still depend on @iyulab/u-widgets ^0.49.0, so adopting 0.50 alone would install two copies of the widget library in the console and the site and register the widget elements twice; adopt it in the commit that takes the next board library and MCP releases, which are built on 0.50
